create_video_decoder_h264: create a VideoCodec with H264 format and use createDecoder to initialize an IVideoDecoder instance
decode_video_frame: call decode_oss_frame on an IVideoDecoder to decode an XPRESS video frame into ImageData
configure_video_codec_hw: configure a VideoCodec with hardware acceleration enabled and a specific implementation name
check_xprs_result: check the XprsResult enum values like OK or ERR_FFMPEG after decoding to handle errors
use_videocodecformat_enum: use the VideoCodecFormat enum to select H264, H265, or VP9 codec format for decoding
